evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC request parsing machinery in src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an edge-case bug where non-object batch elements reuse the previous element's ID or suppress error replies after a notification. As pinheadmz noted, this resolves an omission from the JSON-RPC 2.0 spec that could confuse interface consumers expecting unique IDs in batch responses.
